item.title: Centre County commissioners exploring property reassessment options
item.description: CENTRE COUNTY, Pa. (WTAJ) -- Centre County commissioners are considering a new property reassessment, though the high cost makes the move unlikely. Conducting the process would cost the county more than $6 million.
